scenario.name: static-corpus-row-validator
scenario.description: Offline source/harness contract check for R-CW-5; cannot establish live cap exhaustion.

expectedReceipts.name: static-source-harness-evidence
expectedReceipts.description: Static source and harness checks for the cost-cap reject guard.

expectedReceipts.name: non-live-boundary
expectedReceipts.description: The output explicitly says it is not live R-CW-5 cap-exhaustion evidence.

review.notes: Static boundary check only; it cannot produce or fold a live R-CW-5 PASS. It is the required preflight of R-CW-5: an F″ corpus records it under preflight_attachments, not as a proof row, and R-CW-5 is PASS only when this check passed at the same candidate.

preflightAttachment.notes: Retired as a proof row: F′ and older corpora keep R-CW-5A as the row they folded. Run at the exact candidate, the static validator reads PROOFS/<candidate>/R-CW-5/cael-dgx/, never INDEX static_evidence_sha, and writes required-preflight-receipt.json for grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs and validate-corpus.mjs.

liveRunSafety.notes: Offline validation is intentionally excluded from live-suite and from live R-CW-5 certification.
